Main.dc.html.title: A · One card under a master Notifications switch

Cards.dc.html.title: B · A one-line card per push, behind one Turn on button

Choices.dc.html.title: C · This phone apart from your choices, editable anywhere

row1.text: Settings: a row for each new push

how.text: Press Play, then use the Scenario picker above each phone; tick Commissioner to see the New Feedback row. Rows: Pick reminder, Weekly Win, Close games and New Feedback start on; Chat (All / @mentions / Off) starts at @mentions. Nothing arrives until this phone allows push. The grey line under the picker shows what is saved for the member and what this phone holds. Turning on anything on a phone with no device walks the iPhone prompt.

open.text: What differs: (1) a member with no device on this phone: A shows the saved choices greyed under one master Notifications switch in the card's header, B shows the saved choices greyed behind one Turn on button, C shows the choices live and lets them change anywhere, a computer included. (2) Where the device problem goes: under the card (A), in the gate card (B), in its own This iPhone card (C). Shared on all three: Pick reminder stays first; turning every row off deletes the member's devices (#493).
